ideas.pitch: An ElevenLabs-powered multilingual voice assistant for rural healthcare clinics in Chhattisgarh that conducts preliminary triage in local dialects (like Chhattisgarhi and Hindi) and synthesizes doctor summaries.
ideas.title: VoiceVaidya
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages ElevenLabs sponsor technology to solve a real public interest problem relevant to the local population, catching the eye of sponsor judges.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local public grievance and civic infrastructure reporting platform using ElevenLabs text-to-speech to convert written municipal complaints into automated voice calls for elderly citizens.
ideas.title: AwaazNet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real-world problems of public interest while prominently showcasing the ElevenLabs sponsor tech stack within a 30-hour timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven voice marketplace helper that lets local artisans in Central India describe their crafts in regional dialects using ElevenLabs, automatically generating global e-commerce listings and audio pitches.
ideas.title: BhashaBazaar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on open innovation and economic empowerment of regional artisans, aligning strongly with the Turing Club's mission of solving problems of public interest.

ideas.pitch: An interactive audio textbook generator that takes dense government school syllabi PDFs and turns them into multi-character conversational podcasts using ElevenLabs voice models.
ideas.title: PathshalaVoice
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines education utility with ElevenLabs integration, giving judges a clear demonstration of practical, scalable impact in the student and educational community.

ideas.pitch: An emergency dispatch voice-logger that converts chaotic distress calls into structured JSON incident reports and dispatches localized audio alerts using ElevenLabs voice synthesis.
ideas.title: SanketScript
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides hard engineering value in a high-stakes scenario while incorporating the required ElevenLabs sponsor tools for track consideration.
